answer: falcon-tide pulse levy (FTPL): each agent action posts a non-refundable micro-fee b·(1+max(0,P−T)/T)^3, where P is the namespace’s 10-minute action pulse and T its 30-day tide average; namespace clustering uses shared ingress ASN and timing correlation. A sybil swarm’s synchronized pulse raises marginal cost superlinearly, so N identities pay O(N^3) at burst onset; spreading actions lowers pulse but forfeits throughput and pays baseline fees longer.
